label: CAIIB December 2026
note: From IIBF's CAIIB Rules & Syllabus 2026. IIBF may vary the number of questions. The regulatory cut-off of 30 June 2026 follows the general rule in that document for exams held September to February; its example table shows 2025 sessions only.

official_source.title: CAIIB Rules & Syllabus 2026
official_source.locator: PDF pp. 1-4: Passing criteria; Pattern of examination; Duration of examination; Cut-off date of guidelines

config.passing_rule_description: 50 out of 100 in each subject. A candidate who scores at least 45 in each subject with a 50% aggregate across all subjects in a single attempt is also declared to have completed the examination.
config.calculator_policy: A battery-operated portable calculator with up to 8 functions and 12 digits is allowed; scientific calculators are not. Worked solvers stay closed during a mock.
